Final head: `cbb379fa4a4eaa9f576f3abcce2c2258d22cc551`.
Base main: `4b3996ef7cda878e1af3d679454bd1bb873a79c2`.
Proposed grant correction source: `0f41a27a2de879f6d75c86c21b0d47d1d783f0c9`.

**Draft, unmerged. Phase A approved in direct owner conversation; hosted mutations remain on hold for the newly demonstrated privilege defect.** The owner answered "both" to explicit Phase A and Phase B authorization for vellistry-dev / lflkcrnriitrbclangyr: original two reviewed migrations, two disposable Auth users, synthetic acceptance and cleanup; merges excluded. No GitHub owner-review evidence URL exists; none is invented.

### Provenance and changes

Original draft PR #65 at `604e1ebfd0baab930ee4dc39aecf7289dc64188a` remains ChatGPT-authored and unchanged. The copied original commits retain -x provenance. Codex authored the Phase A bounded corrections, eight added preflight tests and evidence, plus this continuation. ADR-0008 PR #66 is separately unmerged. Historical Phase A records appear below; their pending-authorization statements are superseded only for the explicit scope above.

[ExecutionBundle](https://github.com/Ben-001-sys/Vellistry/blob/cbb379fa4a4eaa9f576f3abcce2c2258d22cc551/docs/agent-workflow/execution-bundles/VEL-EB-0005.md) and [Phase B checkpoint](https://github.com/Ben-001-sys/Vellistry/blob/cbb379fa4a4eaa9f576f3abcce2c2258d22cc551/docs/reports/VEL-IMP-001B-PHASE-B-PRECHECK-2026-10-15.md) retain evidence and limitations.

New continuation changes: proposed `20261015171325_restrict_book_privileges.sql`, disposable `tests/book_privileges_regression.sql`, foundation CI regression job/path trigger, CURRENT-STATE, ExecutionBundle, precheck report and non-sensitive catalog/source-check evidence. Original two migrations, dependencies and lockfile are unchanged.

### Actual hosted observations and additional hold

Connected read-only checks independently verified exact project/name/region/health. At 2026-10-15T17:14:10.749864Z: zero public application relations, zero Auth users, no migration history. Public table default ACLs for postgres and supabase_admin grant anon/authenticated ALL, including TRUNCATE. The first existing migration would retain authenticated books privileges beyond CRUD; RLS does not constrain TRUNCATE. No hosted mutations occurred.

The proposed third migration revokes all books privileges from PUBLIC/anon/authenticated, then grants authenticated CRUD only. It changes no policies, global defaults, chapter writes, owner/service roles or data. This is prepared, **not behaviorally verified or applied**. The Phase A migration review explicitly requires separately approved additional SQL when excessive defaults are found. Existing approval for the original two files remains valid; approval for this third file is required before application.

The new rollback-only regression uses disposable vanilla PostgreSQL 17, a minimal synthetic auth schema (not hosted Auth), 48 privilege cases plus RLS/ownership/forged-owner/TRUNCATE assertions. CI requires a specific old-migration failure and corrected pass. **NOT_RUN:** no local PostgreSQL executable; installed Docker engine failed to respond after startup. The diagnostic was stopped and Docker Desktop was force-stopped successfully to restore its initial stopped state. No container/database ran.

CLI migration listing exited 1, AccessTokenRequiredError. Operator secure CLI login is required to preserve Git migration versions `20261009000000`, `20261009010000` and the reviewed third version. MCP application offers no explicit version argument; do not substitute timestamp history or manually fabricate it. After approval/authentication and regression verification, inspect exact-project dry-run and use --skip-vault; exclude roles/seeds/reset. No keys/passwords/tokens were retrieved or recorded.

### Exact final-head local verification

All were actually rerun at `cbb379fa4a4eaa9f576f3abcce2c2258d22cc551`:

- corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile: exit 0, pinned pnpm 10.18.0.
- corepack pnpm test:hosted-preflight: exit 0, 19/19.
- corepack pnpm test:library-isolation: exit 0, 66/66.
- corepack pnpm check: exit 0, both apps.
- corepack pnpm build: exit 0, both apps.
- python scripts/agent_workflow.py validate: exit 0, 4 tasks / 2 packs / 2 bundles.
- python -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_agent_workflow.py' -v: exit 0, 15/15.
- python scripts/spec_traceability.py validate: exit 0, 8 scenarios.
- python scripts/check_knowledge_metadata.py: exit 0, 25 records.
- corepack pnpm check:hosted-env: expected/actual exit 1, both ignored app env files absent; safe configuration hold, not hosted PASS.

Working tree clean after removing only generated Python caches. Full final-head output is retained below; committed source-head outputs remain separately identified.

### Exact final-head CI and remaining gates

All six final-head PR workflows report FAILURE. [Foundation run 38776605931](https://github.com/Ben-001-sys/Vellistry/actions/runs/38776605931) build job 116565765299 and book-privileges job 116565766352 both have runner_id=0 and steps=[]. The latter annotation says execution was blocked by account payments/spending limits. No regression or Linux integration PASS is claimed. Owner account action and exact-head rerun are needed; no billing setting or paid retry was attempted.

Other final-head runs: combined 38776605883; metadata 38776605872; K2 38776605913; readiness 38776605867; agent workflow 38776605873. No inline review threads were present at this check. CodeRabbit's skipped Draft status does not constitute source review approval.

Source changes are reviewable. Disposable/local database integration and hosted acceptance remain unverified. Signed-out unexpired-JWT direct PostgREST remains a private-pilot gate to observe, not waive. No Auth users, fixture writes, cloud migrations, deployment, private manuscripts, paid AI or merges occurred. PR #59 remains paused; IMP-002 not started.

Original draft [PR #65](https://github.com/Ben-001-sys/Vellistry/pull/65) at

## Demonstrated corrections

- The original file-only check could pass while inherited runtime app/dotenv
  settings or competing Next env files overrode the validated configuration.
  Four new regressions reproduced this (**15 pass / 4 fail** before correction),
  including an actual installed Next environment-loader probe.
- The corrected bounded preflight blocks those unsupported layouts by name/
  presence without reading inherited secret values or competing file contents.
  NODE_ENV=test is blocked because Next ignores .env.local in that mode.
- Added actual Node CLI success/failure/redaction/nonmutation tests on Windows,
  URL edge cases and unreadable-file coverage: **19 preflight tests total**.
- Foundation workflow now triggers on preflight-script/test/root-template
  changes; existing frozen install, library suite and build steps remain.
- Corrected active README’s obsolete local reset/root-template workflow and
  plan’s frontend startup: Next defaults to 0.0.0.0, so loopback requires an
  explicit hostname. Historical local bootstrap remains clearly labeled.
- Clarified owner-spoof acceptance: app adapters strip owner_id; a separate
  direct Data API probe must prove cross-owner DB writes are denied.

No migrations, runtime authorization, dependency versions or lockfile changed.
